title: Food, nature and materials
theme: food and drink, the natural world, materials and animals

blocks.title: Usage tips
blocks.body:
- **False friend:** [[le pétrole]] is crude oil; petrol/gas is [[l'essence]].
- [[Le plomb]]: the b is silent.
- [[Un steak bien cuit]] = well done; [[saignant]] = rare.
- Québec: [[le blé d'Inde]] = corn; [[l'Action de grâce]] = Thanksgiving; [[des patates frites]] = fries.

blocks.prompt: Which sentence is about crude oil?
options: Je mets de l'huile dans la salade.
Le pétrole coûte 1,60 $ le litre à la pompe.
J'achète du pétrole pour mon auto.
blocks.explain: [[Le pétrole]] is crude oil; at the pump you buy [[de l’essence]].
optionFeedback: At the pump you buy [[de l’essence]], not pétrole.

blocks.prompt: The waiter asks how you want your steak. You want it well done:
The children are afraid of the dark.
accept: Les enfants ont peur de l'obscurité.
Les enfants ont peur du noir.

blocks.prompt: The bridge is made of steel.
accept: Le pont est construit en acier.
Le pont est fait en acier.
Le pont est fabriqué en acier.
blocks.explain: Use [[en]] for what something is made of: [[en acier]].

blocks.text: Les pommes de terre sont ___. On peut manger. (cuit)
blocks.en: The potatoes are cooked. We can eat.

It was hit by a wave
